text:
Maya (Growth): Quick thread to finalize the microdemo format for June 3 webinar. Idea: round-robin microdemos (5 speakers x 6min) + 30m deep breakout labs. Need creative, lead routing, and rehearsal plan.

Liz (Speaker Ops): Round-robin sounds tight but high-energy. Ask speakers to keep slides to 3 max + 2-min live demo. Need two rehearsals: one full run (slides + transitions) and one greenroom for mics.

Diego (Creative): For promo, let's do vertical 15s clips per speaker showing a single before/after metric (anecdotal). Visuals: split-screen code + outcome. I can batch-shoot on Wed.

Asha (Demand Gen): Routing: capture breakout preference on registration form (hidden field) + add persona tag (e.g., "platform-engineer", "product-manager"). Map to Marketo fields: breakout_pref, persona_tag. AE routing: flag interest_level=demo -> push to hot queue.

Rohan (Eng): For demos, request no private keys and use tiny public models. I'll provide a mock inference endpoint that returns canned latencies so demos stay reproducible.

Nora (Benchmarks): I'll prepare 3 short benchmark slides per speaker: p50/p95 latency and $/1k tokens for two configs. Keep numbers conservative (bench-to-demo delta).

Maya (Growth): Run-of-show proposal:
00:00-00:05 Host intro + poll (which persona are you?)
00:05-00:35 Round-robin microdemos (5 x 6min)
00:35-01:05 Breakouts (3 rooms, 10m hands-on + 5m q&a)
01:05-01:25 Panel + audience q&a
01:25-01:30 CTAs + survey

Liz (Speaker Ops): Rehearsal windows: June 1 11:00-12:00 PT (full run) and June 3 09:30-10:00 PT (greenroom). Can speakers confirm? I'll send invites once confirmed.

Diego (Creative): Deliverables: 15s promo vertical + 30s speaker highlight. I'll need speaker one-liners and headshot by Fri.

Asha (Demand Gen): Email cadence: invite, reminder (72h), reminder (24h), day-of (1h). Also create nurture tracks based on breakout_pref. Can we tag registrants by persona for messaging?

Maya (Growth): Yes. Tagging by persona will help tailor post-event CTAs (workbook vs. enterprise eval). Also capture "follow_with_sdr" checkbox on form.

Rohan (Eng): Webhook payload we recommend for /events/webinar-roundrobin:

```
POST /events/webinar-roundrobin
email=...&company=...&breakout_pref=...&persona_tag=...&follow_with_sdr=true&utm_source=...
```

(Note: form sends URL-encoded fields).

Nora (Benchmarks): Small ask: make sure the slide deck includes an appendix with the exact commands and config used for bench numbers so curious attendees can reproduce.

Liz (Speaker Ops): Will create a 1-page speaker cheat sheet: time allotments, transitions, and how to handoff to next speaker. Also request a backup contact.

Diego (Creative): Also propose 3 teaser GIFs for socials showing microdemo clips. Short loop, CTA overlay. I can drop assets to the drive by Mon.

Asha (Demand Gen): Lead mapping: Marketo list=Webinar_RoundRobin_Jun3; SFDC Campaign=Webinar_RoundRobin_2024-06-03; webhook-> /events/webinar-roundrobin. We'll create smart campaigns per persona.

Maya (Growth): Action items: Diego deliver promos + GIFs by Mon; Nora upload benchmark appendix + 3 configs by Fri; Rohan spin up mock endpoint + sample payload by Thu; Liz schedule rehearsals and collect speaker bios by Fri. Asha to draft email sequence by Tue.

GreenroomBot: Rehearsal events created: June 1 11:00 PT (full run), June 3 09:30 PT (greenroom). Calendar invites sent to participants.

Maya (Growth): final note: keep demos reproducible, short, and persona-forward. I'll lock format tomorrow unless objections. Thanks team! :rocket!
